_comment: Canonical Prop Farm recipes — the known-good inputs for each prop so regenerating reproduces the same detail level (prompt drift was the cause of 'why did the mesh change'). prop_pull.py --name <key> loads this when --prompt is omitted. Note: even with identical inputs the GPU pipeline isn't bit-deterministic, but the DETAIL level is governed by the prompt+seed here.
_prompt_convention: Describe the SUBJECT + its real materials/colours ONLY (e.g. 'a table saw, cast-iron grey top, charcoal steel frame, orange motor, silver blade'). Do NOT add 'low poly', 'flat shading', 'Synty', etc. — the reference generator (gen_prop_ref_comfy.py) appends a fixed STYLE suffix with all of that to EVERY prompt automatically; repeating it only dilutes the subject tokens. The Synty look is centralised there (single knob, Windows-side); tune STYLE if you want it stronger, not these prompts.
_size_convention: height = real-world bbox height in metres (GLB ships true-sized → wire with prop(path,pos,yaw) scale 1.0). poly = painted pre-paint tri budget (set-dressing ~1500-2500, hero ~4000-6000).

tuning_bench.prompt: a sturdy wooden carpenter's workbench with a dark walnut top and four turned legs, a low back rack holding a row of upright slim silver steel rods, a black iron vise clamped to one end, and brass and chrome hand tools lying flat on the top

table_saw.prompt: a single complete woodworking table saw machine, one unit centered in frame: a flat cast-iron grey metal table top, a charcoal-black steel frame and four legs, a bright orange motor housing on the side, one silver circular saw blade above the table, a yellow rip-fence rail

organ.prompt: one tall pipe organ, a single instrument centered: a dark-walnut wood console with a cream and black keyboard, topped with a prominent bank of tall golden brass pipes, ornate brass trim

zip_tower.prompt: a tall outdoor zip-line launch tower, a square wooden timber frame with diagonal cross-braces, a railed platform deck on top, a steel ladder up one side, weathered grey timber and galvanised steel

zip_control_panel.prompt: a single outdoor control kiosk on a steel pedestal, a dark weatherproof metal box with a small glowing screen and a row of buttons

zip_release.prompt: a launch gate post: a single vertical steel post with a horizontal swing-arm gate bar and a red-and-green signal light on top

zip_winch.prompt: an industrial cable winch, a steel drum wound with cable on a yellow motor housing base

zip_trolley.prompt: a zip-line pulley trolley: two grooved metal wheels side by side gripping a horizontal cable at the top, a curved steel handlebar hanging below

warden_kiosk.prompt: a small outdoor warden ranger hut with a service-window counter and a shingled gable roof, timber walls with green-painted panels

hay_bale.prompt: a single round straw hay bale, cylindrical, tightly wrapped

clue_bag.prompt: a canvas duffel bag with buckled leather straps, closed, lying on its side

hedge.prompt: a freestanding section of a dense green garden hedge, entirely covered in green leafy foliage on the top and all four sides, trimmed flat, no flower pot, no planter box, no soil, no stone or concrete base, just the green shrub
